description: This file is a Python script for a plugin skeleton generator, involving user prompts, YAML configuration parsing, interface parsing, and code generation coordination.

methods.name: loadYAML
methods.description: Loads and parses a YAML configuration file, with error handling for file existence and YAML syntax.

methods.name: validatePaths
methods.description: Checks that all provided header file paths exist, printing errors and exiting if not.

methods.name: collectList
methods.description: Collects multiple string entries from user input until an empty line is entered.

methods.name: prompts
methods.description: Interacts with the user to gather plugin configuration details, including plugin name, process type, header files, and subsystems.

methods.name: parserInterfaces
methods.description: Parses header files to extract interface class data and header lookup information.

methods.name: displayParsedData
methods.description: Displays parsed interface data and associated headers.

methods.name: _root
methods.description: Extracts the root name from a fully qualified interface name.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Main function that manages command-line arguments, configuration loading, interface parsing, user selection, and code generation coordination.
